<document id="fee-changes-2026">
WhatˆchangedˆinˆtheˆMarchˆ2026ˆfeeˆupdateˆWeˆupdatedˆourˆfeesˆonˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆHere'sˆeverythingˆthatˆchangedˆandˆwhatˆstayedˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangedˆ-ˆ**Plusˆmonthlyˆfee:**ˆfromˆ$4.00ˆtoˆ$5.00.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆfromˆ1.5%ˆtoˆ1%.ˆ-ˆ**Out-of-networkˆATMˆfeeˆonˆBasicˆandˆPlus:**ˆfromˆ$2.00ˆtoˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawals:**ˆfromˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstayedˆtheˆsameˆBasicˆisˆstillˆfree.ˆPremiumˆisˆstillˆ$15.00ˆaˆmonthˆwithˆnoˆATMˆorˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees.ˆCardˆreplacement,ˆwireˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfeesˆdidn'tˆchangeˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhyˆweˆmadeˆtheseˆchangesˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆoperatorsˆraisedˆwhatˆtheyˆchargeˆus,ˆandˆweˆmovedˆpartˆofˆthatˆcostˆintoˆtheˆfee.ˆWeˆloweredˆtheˆPlusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆatˆtheˆsameˆtime,ˆsoˆPlusˆmembersˆwhoˆtravelˆpayˆlessˆoverall.ˆIfˆtheˆnewˆPlusˆpriceˆdoesn'tˆworkˆforˆyou,ˆyouˆcanˆmoveˆtoˆBasicˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffectˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="transfers-ach-cutoff-v2">
ACHˆtransferˆcutoffˆtimesˆStandardˆtransfersˆtoˆandˆfromˆyourˆlinkedˆbankˆaccountsˆuseˆACH,ˆwhichˆonlyˆprocessesˆonˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆCutoffˆtimeˆTransfersˆyouˆsubmitˆbeforeˆ4:00ˆPMˆETˆonˆaˆbusinessˆdayˆareˆsentˆthatˆday.ˆTransfersˆsubmittedˆafterˆ4:00ˆPMˆET,ˆorˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆbankˆholiday,ˆareˆsentˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheˆmoneyˆarrivesˆOnceˆsent,ˆACHˆtransfersˆusuallyˆarriveˆinˆ1ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆTheˆotherˆbankˆdecidesˆwhenˆtoˆmakeˆtheˆmoneyˆavailable.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆyouˆsendˆmoneyˆonˆaˆFridayˆafterˆ4:00ˆPMˆET,ˆit'sˆsentˆonˆMondayˆ(orˆTuesdayˆifˆMondayˆisˆaˆholiday).ˆ##ˆFasterˆoptionsˆ-ˆBrookPayˆtransfersˆtoˆotherˆTallowbrookˆmembersˆarriveˆinˆseconds,ˆeveryˆday.ˆ-ˆDomesticˆwiresˆarriveˆtheˆsameˆbusinessˆdayˆifˆsentˆbeforeˆtheˆwireˆcutoff.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆDailyˆandˆmonthlyˆACHˆlimitsˆdependˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆSeeˆtheˆtransferˆlimitsˆarticleˆforˆyourˆplan.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="account-eligibility">
WhoˆcanˆopenˆanˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆopenˆaˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆifˆyou:ˆ-ˆAreˆatˆleastˆ18ˆyearsˆoldˆ-ˆLiveˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆhaveˆaˆUSˆresidentialˆaddressˆ(notˆaˆPOˆbox)ˆ-ˆHaveˆaˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITINˆ-ˆHaveˆanˆunexpiredˆgovernment-issuedˆphotoˆIDˆ-ˆHaveˆaˆsmartphoneˆthatˆcanˆrunˆtheˆTallowbrookˆappˆ##ˆOpeningˆanˆaccountˆDownloadˆtheˆappˆandˆtapˆGetˆstarted.ˆYou'llˆenterˆyourˆdetails,ˆtakeˆaˆphotoˆofˆyourˆIDˆandˆaˆselfie.ˆEveryˆaccountˆstartsˆonˆBasic,ˆandˆyouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆonceˆyou'reˆverified.ˆ##ˆOneˆaccountˆperˆpersonˆEachˆpersonˆcanˆhaveˆoneˆTallowbrookˆaccount.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccounts,ˆbusinessˆaccountsˆorˆaccountsˆforˆpeopleˆunderˆ18.ˆ##ˆLivingˆabroadˆIfˆyouˆmoveˆabroadˆpermanently,ˆyouˆmayˆneedˆtoˆcloseˆyourˆaccount.ˆTellˆusˆbeforeˆyouˆmove.ˆ##ˆPreviouslyˆclosedˆbyˆusˆIfˆTallowbrookˆclosedˆanˆaccountˆofˆyoursˆinˆtheˆpast,ˆaˆnewˆapplicationˆmayˆbeˆdeclined.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
